sources.ref: TANCHJIM Android app 2.5.7.4 (com.tanchjim.android): the device table and how it finds a device by USB vendor and product id

meta.notes: The app reads the USB id a device keeps in flash (0x0D at a chip-specific address) only to recover one that comes up as 0x0666:0x0888 after a failed update; its table gives 0x3302:0x4381 for the Space II.
